title: Made this game for my gf cause she hates mosquito.
author: National_Flower7240
selftext: Im trying to make my gf hate mosquito less by making a game for her to play as a mosquito. For now the mechanic of the game is pretty simple, im still thinking about how to make her sympathize for a mosquito after playing this game. Desperately need suggestions. Here’s a link if u wanna try it out, but it’s a work in progress so still a bit buggy: [https://taluna.ai/game/share/rnzXvrjX/v4](https://taluna.ai/game/share/rnzXvrjX/v4)

comments.author: Brapchu
comments.body:
That's literally just the PS2 game Mister Mosquito that was plagia.. I meant recreated by your AI companion:

[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mister\_Mosquito](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mister_Mosquito)

replies.author: National_Flower7240
replies.body: Haha I actually had NO idea this PS2 game existed! I guess my AI’s training data really loved obscure 2000s games 😂 Well, time to watch some Mister Mosquito gameplay for 'research' purposes!

comments.author: Conscious_Regret_140
comments.body: Why the heck would she need to empathise with mozzies???

replies.author: National_Flower7240
replies.body: Honestly? I have no idea 😂 It started out as a random joke, and now I’m too deep into the development to back out. I just wanted to see if game design can actually make someone sympathize with the most annoying creature on earth

comments.author: CosminNicu7
comments.body: So, a worst version of the PS2 classic *Mister Mosquito*

replies.author: National_Flower7240
replies.body: Hey, 'worst version of a PS2 classic' is still a pretty high compliment for a buggy AI prototype! 😂 I'll gladly take it.

replies.author: nfxdav
replies.body: I don't think it was a compliment at all...
